description: C4 (decision C4-8): Thornwick's development, in the Valley - its first tier is B2's aftermath (the Ogre King's trophy stand, an auto project), its second the King's bell hung in a frame the giant raises over the square, with the bronze he took from the King.

tiers.name: The Village
tiers.text: A walled village in the Valley that paid the Ogre King in barley and fear.

tiers.name: The King's Trophies
tiers.text: The King's crown, wheels and ram stand on a trophy stand in the square; his bell lies set down by it.

unlocks.text: Thornwick's smithy works the King's trophies (the Kingsfall set).

projects.name: The King's trophies
projects.text: The village raises a stand for what you took from the King, once you have gone.

tiers.name: The Bell Hung
tiers.text: The King's bell hangs in a frame of whole trunks over the square, rung at dusk.

unlocks.text: Thornwick's smith trades two wolf hides for an iron ingot.
The square is full on bell-nights.

projects.name: Hang the King's bell
projects.text: Elder Maren wants the King's bell rung over the square, not lying in the mud - but its bronze is cracked where you broke it from him, and its frame wants trunks no team of oxen could stand up.
projects.raised_text: You stand the frame's trunks and hang the bell. Its first stroke is cracked and wonderful.

needs.text: The King's bell-bronze, to mend its crack
Break the deadfall off the barrow road (the trunks for its frame)
